patch_description: I redesigned the ansatz as a compact staged block instead of a uniform global mixer. Each block now follows a clearer data flow: parity-separated single-qubit mixing, local phase-to-amplitude conversion on nearest pairs, long-range bridge entanglement, a global phase refinement, and a final readout compressor. This keeps the parameter count low while adding more structured interactions than the previous symmetric layer stack, which should improve validation/test generalization and preserve parameter efficiency.
